internal.title: Incident Report: Cart Service Error Rate Spike Due to Flag Activation
internal.body: At 12:17 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for the cart service due to a high error rate. Investigation identified a recent flag activation ('cartFailure') as the root cause, which injected errors into the service. The flag was disabled at 12:37 UTC after approval, leading to a verified recovery with error rates returning to normal levels. No resource exhaustion or latency issues were found. The incident was resolved promptly with minimal impact on service availability.

external.title: Intermittent Cart Service Errors Resolved
external.body: Between 12:17 and 12:37 UTC on 2026-11-08, some customers experienced intermittent errors when using the cart service. Our team identified the cause and resolved the issue by disabling a recent configuration change. The service has returned to normal operation, and we apologize for any inconvenience caused.
